caption: Quick Support before the test: four steps from creating an invitation to the connection, and a 14 day trial banner at the top. No card was asked for the trial.

An invitation was ready in two clicks. The window says the client must run an attached file before you can control their desktop, so this is not a browser only link. The invite link and code are hidden.
Role Management comes with system roles for devices, invitations and administration, including Billing Administrator and API Keys administrator. We did not invite a technician.
The trial runs until 03.12.2026 with limits of 500 devices and 5 technicians, and unlimited Quick Support invitations.
The Business plan for 10 devices and 1 technician costs EUR 9.50 a month or EUR 7.90 a month billed yearly. No trial is offered on this plan. We did not click Buy Now.
